title: The Lost Bookshop
author: Evie Woods
description: A story woven across time, connecting three people through a mysterious bookshop that exists between streets and centuries, where books have a way of finding the readers who need them most.

title: The Upstarts
author: Brad Stone
description: The inside story of how Uber and Airbnb defied every conventional rule, disrupted entire industries, and remade the world — told by the journalist who had the closest access to both companies at their most chaotic.

title: The Fountainhead
author: Ayn Rand
description: The story of Howard Roark, an uncompromising architect who refuses to surrender his vision to convention or popular taste — a towering argument for individualism, integrity, and the creative spirit at any cost.

title: The Time Traveler's Wife
author: Audrey Niffenegger
description: A love story unlike any other — a man with a genetic disorder that pulls him involuntarily through time, and the woman who must love him across a life that is never quite linear, never quite safe.

title: The Forty Rules of Love
author: Elif Shafak
description: Two stories running in parallel — a modern woman discovering a manuscript about the transformative friendship between the poet Rumi and the wandering dervish Shams of Tabriz — and the forty rules of love that connect them.
